notes.title: New Release - Puzzler World 2, 20% off plus free copy of Puzzler World 1!
notes.notes:
Puzzler World 2 is now available on Steam and is 20% off and you receive a free copy of Puzzler World (Already own it, give this copy to a friend) until October 24th at 10AM Pacific Time.

The highly anticipated sequel to last year’s PC hit, Puzzler World 2 brings more puzzles, new games, fun rewards and an all new Master Mode.
